title: Speak in Context: Multilingual ASR with Speech Context Alignment via Contrastive Learning
abstract: arXiv:2603.06505v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) has benefited from advances in pretrained speech and language models, yet most systems remain constrained to monolingual settings and short, isolated utterances. While recent efforts in context-aware ASR show promise, two key challenges persist: limited multilingual support and the absence of principled alignment between speech and contextual representations. In this paper, we introduce a context-aware multilingual ASR framework that supports diverse languages and accents while preserving the modularity of pretrained models. Our approach combines a frozen speech encoder and a decoder-only language model via a lightweight projection module, allowing structured context prompts, including dialogue history and biasing words, to guide transcription. To improve interaction between speech and context, we employ a contrastive learning objective that aligns their representations in a shared embedding space.

translated_title: 语境中说话：通过对比学习实现语音上下文对齐的多语言自动语音识别
translated_abstract: 自动语音识别（ASR）受益于预训练语音和语言模型的进步，但大多数系统仍局限于单语言设置和短小的孤立话语。尽管近期在上下文感知ASR方面的努力显示出潜力，但两个关键挑战依然存在：多语言支持有限，以及语音与上下文表示之间缺乏原则性的对齐。在本文中，我们引入了一个上下文感知的多语言ASR框架，支持多种语言和口音，同时保持预训练模型的模块化。我们的方法通过轻量级投影模块结合冻结的语音编码器和仅解码器的语言模型，允许结构化上下文提示（包括对话历史和偏置词）来指导转录。为了改善语音与上下文之间的交互，我们采用对比学习目标，在共享嵌入空间中对齐它们的表示。
tldr: 本文提出了一种上下文感知的多语言ASR框架，通过对比学习对齐语音和上下文表示，支持多种语言和口音，同时保持预训练模型的模块化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a context-aware multilingual ASR framework that aligns speech and context representations via contrastive learning, supporting diverse languages and accents while preserving modularity of pretrained models.
